description: Scrape the public Snapchat Ads Library (Ads Gallery) for advertiser ads, sponsored content, and creator-sponsored posts across the EU and Turkey.

advertiserMatch.description: contains (default) uses Snap's partial payer-name search. exact keeps only ads whose paying advertiser exactly equals one of your names, ignoring case and extra whitespace.
advertiserMatch.title: Advertiser Match

countries.description: 2-letter country codes to filter ads by. Leave empty for all. Supported: the 27 EU codes at, be, bg, cy, cz, de, dk, ee, el (Greece), es, fi, fr, hr, hu, ie, it, lt, lu, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, se, si, sk, tr (Turkey). gr is accepted as an alias for el. UK (gb/uk) and US are not in the library.
countries.title: Countries

creatorName.description: For creatorSearch mode: creator username or display name used to search sponsored content.
creatorName.title: Creator Name

endDate.description: Filter ads that ran on or before this date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD). The API does not publish an ad end date in records.
endDate.title: End Date

includeCoverage.description: Add one coverage row per advertiser/creator listing matched payer names, status, pages fetched, duplicates removed, countries, and impression coverage.
includeCoverage.title: Include Coverage Rows

maxResults.description: Maximum records to save per advertiser in adSearch, or total records in sponsoredContent/creatorSearch. The actor paginates the public API automatically (10 ads per request for adSearch, up to 200 items per page for sponsored content).
maxResults.title: Max Results per Advertiser

mode.description: adSearch searches ads by paying advertiser, sponsoredContent browses all live sponsored content, and creatorSearch searches sponsored content by creator.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

payingAdvertiserName.description: Single-advertiser legacy input, still supported. Prefer Advertiser Names. If both are set, the names are merged and deduplicated.
payingAdvertiserName.title: Advertiser Name (single, legacy)

payingAdvertiserNames.description: For adSearch mode: one or more paying-advertiser names, e.g. Nike, Amazon, Zalando. The API matches partial names case-insensitively; set Advertiser Match to exact for case-insensitive exact payer matching.
payingAdvertiserNames.title: Advertiser Names

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. The Ads Library API is public and normally works without a proxy; enable one only if your runs keep hitting rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

startDate.description: Filter ads that ran on or after this date (ISO 8601 or YYYY-MM-DD). The library only covers the last 12 months; older dates may return nothing.
startDate.title: Start Date

status.description: Filter ads by current status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, or ALL.
status.title: Ad Status

title: Snapchat Ads Gallery Scraper
